about: Scugog Township is a rural municipality in Durham Region, Ontario, centred on Lake Scugog and the town of Port Perry. Shoreline villages, farms, and cottage country share the township with the Mississaugas of Scugog Island First Nation’s neighbouring territory. Highway 7A and rural roads link toward Oshawa and Peterborough. About 22,000 people live in Scugog Township.
seoSummary: Durham Region township around Port Perry and Lake Scugog—lakeside town and countryside, not a city.
